look-gallery.preview.anim-warn.text: This look is animated. It can slow older tablets and wall displays.
look-gallery.preview.anim-warn.note: Warning in the preview bar for an animated look.

look-gallery.preview.area-card.note: Name of the card-level group in the What changes list.

look-gallery.preview.area-type.note: Name of a module group in the What changes list.

vars.type: The module type, such as button.

look-gallery.preview.cancel.note: Button of the preview bar that ends the preview and leaves the card as it was.

look-gallery.preview.changes-count.text: {count, plural, one {# style setting} other {# style settings}}
look-gallery.preview.changes-count.note: Total of settings that Keep writes or clears.

look-gallery.preview.changes-note.text: These settings replace the values your card has now. Undo brings them back.
look-gallery.preview.changes-note.note: Note under the What changes heading.

look-gallery.preview.changes-title.note: Heading of the list of settings that Keep replaces.

look-gallery.preview.cleared.note: Label before the settings a look clears in the What changes list.

look-gallery.preview.details.note: Button of the preview bar that shows or hides the details.

look-gallery.preview.font-ok.text: {font} loads on every screen, because Load Google Fonts is on.
look-gallery.preview.font-ok.note: Calm line in the preview bar for a look that names a Google font.

vars.font: The font names, joined by commas.

look-gallery.preview.keep.note: Main button of the preview bar; copies the look into the card.

look-gallery.preview.pause.note: Button that pauses the animation of the previewed look.

look-gallery.preview.play.note: Button that starts the animation of the previewed look.

look-gallery.preview.region.note: Accessible name of the bar under the tiles while a look is previewed.

look-gallery.preview.set.note: Label before the settings a look writes in the What changes list.

look-gallery.preview.status.note: Status line of the preview bar.

look-gallery.preview.summary.text: Keep applies this look's colours, fonts and shapes to this card. Your entities, text, actions and templates stay unchanged.
look-gallery.preview.summary.note: Sentence in the details of the preview bar that says what Keep does.

look-gallery.reason.c-tamper.text: The saved copy failed its check and was discarded.
look-gallery.reason.c-tamper.note: Reason shown when the saved list failed its check.

look-gallery.reason.i-parse.text: The list could not be read.
look-gallery.reason.i-parse.note: Reason shown when the list is malformed or too large.

look-gallery.reason.i-roll.text: The list is older than the one saved on this device.
look-gallery.reason.i-roll.note: Reason shown when the list is older than the saved one.

look-gallery.reason.i-sig.text: The signature of the list did not check out.
look-gallery.reason.i-sig.note: Reason shown when the list signature is wrong.

look-gallery.reason.i-ver.text: The list uses a format this version of Magic Card does not know. Update Magic Card.
look-gallery.reason.i-ver.note: Reason shown when the list format is unknown.

look-gallery.reason.l-fetch.text: This look could not be loaded.
look-gallery.reason.l-fetch.note: Reason shown on a look that could not be fetched.

look-gallery.reason.l-grammar.text: This look needs a newer version of Magic Card. Update Magic Card.
look-gallery.reason.l-grammar.note: Reason shown on a blocked look that uses a newer look format.

look-gallery.reason.l-hash.text: This look changed after it was checked, so it is blocked.
look-gallery.reason.l-hash.note: Reason shown on a blocked look whose file does not match its checksum.

look-gallery.reason.l-meta.text: This look does not match its description in the list, so it is blocked.
look-gallery.reason.l-meta.note: Reason shown on a blocked look whose animated or font details differ from the list.

look-gallery.reason.l-parse.text: This look contains more than style settings, so it is blocked.
look-gallery.reason.l-parse.note: Reason shown on a blocked look that failed the style-only check.

look-gallery.reason.n-fetch.text: The gallery could not be reached.
look-gallery.reason.n-fetch.note: Reason shown when the gallery cannot be reached.

look-gallery.tile.animated.note: Chip on a look tile and in the preview bar when the look moves.

look-gallery.tile.by.note: Author line on a look tile.

vars.author: The look author name from the signed list.

look-gallery.tile.chip.note: Chip on a look tile: the look holds style settings only and passed the checks.

look-gallery.tile.code.note: Small secondary text with the short code of why a look is blocked.

vars.code: The short code, such as L-HASH.

look-gallery.tile.font.note: Chip on a look tile when the look names a Google font.

look-gallery.tile.label.text: {name}, by {author}, {spdx}, style only, verified{fonts, select, yes {, uses Google Fonts} other {}}{animated, select, yes {, animated} other {}}
look-gallery.tile.label.note: Accessible name of a look tile; fonts and animated are yes or no.

vars.animated: yes when the look is animated, otherwise no.
vars.author: The look author.
vars.fonts: yes when the look names a Google font, otherwise no.
vars.name: The look name.

look-gallery.tile.licence.note: Licence line on a look tile.

vars.spdx: The licence identifier, such as MIT.

look-gallery.tile.refused-section.note: Heading above the looks that are blocked.

look-gallery.tile.report.note: Link text on a blocked look that opens the gallery issue form.

look-gallery.tile.report-label.text: Tell the gallery owner about {name} (needs a GitHub account, opens in a new tab)
look-gallery.tile.report-label.note: Accessible name of the report link on a blocked look.

look-gallery.window.back.note: Button at the top of the gallery that leaves the gallery. Hidden while a look is previewed.

look-gallery.window.close.note: Accessible name of the close button of the gallery window.

look-gallery.window.error-code.note: Small secondary text with the short code of a refusal.

vars.code: The short code of the refusal, such as I-SIG.

look-gallery.window.error-title.text: The gallery could not be loaded
look-gallery.window.error-title.note: Heading of the error state when the list was refused and there is no saved copy.

look-gallery.window.grid-label.note: Accessible name of the group of look tiles (a radio group).

look-gallery.window.intro.text: Looks change how a card looks, never what it does. Your entities, text and actions stay as they are.
look-gallery.window.intro.note: Sentence under the title of the gallery window; sets what a look can and cannot change.

look-gallery.window.loading.note: Status text while the gallery list is being fetched.

look-gallery.window.notice-old.text: This list passed its expiry date. Looks still work, but newer ones may be missing.
look-gallery.window.notice-old.note: Notice above the tiles when the signed list is past its expiry date.

look-gallery.window.notice-refused.text: The new list was refused, so a saved copy is shown. {reason} Code {code}
look-gallery.window.notice-refused.note: Alert above the tiles when the fetched list was refused and a saved copy is used instead.

vars.code: The short code of the refusal, such as I-SIG.
vars.reason: The fixed reason sentence of the refusal.

look-gallery.window.notice-saved.text: Showing a saved copy of the list.
look-gallery.window.notice-saved.note: Notice above the tiles when the list comes from this device because the gallery could not be reached.

look-gallery.window.offline-body.text: You are offline and there is no saved copy yet. Connect, then try again.
look-gallery.window.offline-body.note: Body of the empty state when the gallery cannot be reached and nothing is saved.

look-gallery.window.offline-title.note: Heading of the empty state when the gallery cannot be reached and nothing is saved.

look-gallery.window.report.note: Link text that opens the gallery issue form when the whole list is refused.

look-gallery.window.report-open.text: Tell the gallery owner (needs a GitHub account, opens in a new tab)
look-gallery.window.report-open.note: Accessible name of the report link under an error state.

look-gallery.window.retry.note: Button that fetches the gallery list again.

look-gallery.window.title.note: Title of the full-screen looks gallery window.

look-gallery.window.zero-title.note: Heading of the empty state when the gallery list is valid but holds no looks.
